standing.made-by: Determinable for 23,724 entries from their brand strings; waits on the generated pass specified in docs/ONTOLOGY-RESEARCH.md 4.2 so it lands with its own gate rather than by hand.
standing.certified-by: Six certification tags exist to anchor it; waits on the same generated pass so each edge cites the certifier register, not the tag.
standing.supplies: No sourced supplier relationships in the corpus yet; a supply-chain claim needs a register or a filing behind it before the first edge ships.
standing.analogous-to: Reserved for cross-domain likeness once alternative-to is dense inside domains; an analogy before that would be decoration.
standing.in-domain: Containment already lives in the two trees; this predicate serializes it for JSON-LD consumers and should be generated from the taxonomy, never authored.

noUrlEdges.reason: Fourteen ownership edges into stub orgs predate the citation rule; grandfathered on 2026-08-26 and ratcheted down from eighteen when the four banking alternatives gained their receipts. Any new edge must carry a source URL.
